info.name: OpenMetadata APIs Agent Executions Workflow Instances API

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of Workflow Instances returned. (1 to 1000000, default = 10)

params.name: offset
params.description: Returns list of Workflow Instances at the offset

params.name: startTs
params.description: Filter Workflow Instances after the given start timestamp

params.name: endTs
params.description: Filter Workflow Instances before the given end timestamp

params.name: latest
params.description: Only list the latest Workflow Instance

items.docs: Get a list of all the workflow instances, filtered by `startTs` and `endTs` of the creation, and Workflow Definition FQN. Use cursor-based pagination to limit the number of entries in the list using `limit` and `before` or `after` query params.
